summary: M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands on experience building and fine tuning Transformer based generative models in PyTorch. Implemented a GPT-2 style language model from scratch and used Hugging Face Transformers to fine tune a document understanding model, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%. Applied 8-bit quantization and benchmarking to cut a 1.1B parameter language model's memory footprint by 55% with under 1% accuracy loss, and built a from-scratch Transformer based ASR pipeline achieving 15% word error rate.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.
Engineered a custom data pipeline with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, restructuring task distribution to deliver the pipeline within a 6-week window.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.
Trained on a small fantasy-themed text corpus; validated text generation and model understanding of Transformer architecture fundamentals.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase, near-lossless compression.
Evaluated trade-offs between model efficiency and task performance for edge deployment constraints.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples (NPTEL 2020) achieving training loss ~0.51.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python.
Achieved 15% WER on Hindi-English dataset while reducing preprocessing latency via optimized tokenization.
